runners_data.name: Cloudio
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with a placed effort on good ground in his form string; OR 100 and top weight alongside Gino Bella, but 111 days off is a concern for immediate peak fitness, and Oliver McKiernan's string has only hit 3/11 in the last fortnight.
runners_data.comment: Cloudio was 4th and 5th two and three starts back and already goes well over today's trip, though his latest was a modest 7th. Winless in that spell but rated 105, he's a leading danger - a 111-day absence the chief concern.

runners_data.name: Gino Bella
runners_data.note: The sole confirmed front-runner here, though the STYLE_FIT flag (0.90) cautions he may be racing out of his ideal role; six runs in similar going produce four placed efforts, and Alan O'Sullivan (5lb claim) adds value if he can control fractions without burning the horse up.
runners_data.comment: Gino Bella was 3rd last time and has a runner-up effort deeper in her form, with today's trip and ground already proven. Winless in that spell but rated 102, she is a leading danger to our selection — a mid-campaign pulled-up run the only real blot.

runners_data.name: Eaglewood
runners_data.note: True hold-up type returning from 277 days off for Leonard Paul Flynn; eight runs on good ground include a win, and the step back to 2m1f from longer trips suits, but the layoff is a significant unknown in a competitive 26-runner handicap.
runners_data.comment: Eaglewood was 3rd on her latest start but hasn't run for 277 days, a fitness question after 8th and 6th in between. She does have today's trip and ground already proven, and a rating of 101 keeps her firmly in the frame.

runners_data.name: Jay Pee M
runners_data.note: Prominent racer whose recent form includes a B (bolted) and a pulled-up, which raises jumping reliability concerns; six runs on good ground show only one placing, and the trainer has had just one winner from six over the last 14 days.
runners_data.comment: Jay Pee M's latest ended in a non-finish when brought down, though he was 5th the run before and has today's trip and ground covered. Top-rated at 111, clear of this field, he sets the standard, with the 41-day layoff the one query.

runners_data.name: Laurie Blue
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse carrying the Jack Kennedy booking, which is the standout jockey appointment in the race; ten runs on good ground yield one win and one place, and the tp headgear combo suggests connections are trying to sharpen his finishing effort.
runners_data.comment: Laurie Blue was 4th the run before her unplaced latest effort, and already has today's trip and ground summed up. Winless in that spell but rated 102, she's a leading danger, with a pulled-up run among her recent starts the main concern.

runners_data.name: Miss Gitana
runners_data.note: Flagged as a hold-up type who fades in the finish, which is a double concern in a race likely to be run at a steady pace where the sprint home will test her; 317 days off and limited good-ground winning form compound the risk.
runners_data.comment: Miss Gitana ran a fair 2nd earlier in this short sequence but has managed only 8th in each of her last two starts, though today's trip and ground are already proven. Rated 93, she sits just outside the leading pack and needs to rediscover that form to feature.

runners_data.name: Northern Ruler
runners_data.note: Another fader in the finish flag and just eight days since last run — very quick return — with a trainer who has had no winners from 14 runners over the past fortnight; four runs on good ground show only one place from the rear.
runners_data.comment: Northern Ruler has managed just a 6th in his last four starts, with three unplaced efforts either side. He's quick to reappear, just 8 days on, and already knows today's trip, but rated 93 he needs a marked step forward to feature.

runners_data.name: Dictionary Corner
runners_data.note: Unclassified style, which creates positional uncertainty in a big field; four good-ground runs show no wins or places, and the 7lb claimer Thomas O'Connor adds a further unknown element in a 26-runner cavalry charge.
runners_data.comment: Dictionary Corner has managed nothing better than 6th in her last five starts, including a pulled-up run and a refusal, and a rating of 72 leaves her among the outsiders. She does have today's ground already proven, but there's little to inspire confidence.

runners_data.name: Kelly's Cosmos
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose best result on good ground (3rd in handicap company) came over this sort of trip; the trainer has had one winner from 12 runners in the last fortnight, and the form line 438-60 offers limited encouragement at this class level.
runners_data.comment: Kelly's Cosmos showed a fair 3rd earlier in this run but has since been let down by an 8th, a 6th and an unplaced effort last time, though he already has today's trip and ground covered. Rated 95, he is respectably placed in this field but needs to rediscover that better form.

runners_data.name: Urban War
runners_data.note: An eight-year-old hold-up horse who has struggled to reproduce his best on good ground (10 runs, no wins); the hg:t headgear and 35-day break are noted, but the form figures 700-0 suggest he is a tail-ender risk in a busy field.
runners_data.comment: Urban War has been well held in three of his last four starts, with only a 7th to show, and the yard's recent 1-from-20 record adds concern. He does have today's trip and ground covered, and rated 94 he remains competitive, though confidence is limited.

runners_data.name: Footstepstoglory
runners_data.note: A genuine hold-up horse by nature but placed into midfield on the map because the field cannot accommodate all closers at the rear; returning from 265 days off over a trip shorter than his placed form (2nd over 16f) and the style-fit discount (0.92) should temper expectations.
runners_data.comment: Footstepstoglory was a promising 2nd on his latest start, though the form either side (5th, 8th, 7th and an unplaced effort) is patchier, and he already knows today's trip. Rated 83, he sits mid-pack on a book that's more encouraging than consistent.

runners_data.name: Let It Settle
runners_data.note: True hold-up horse pushed forward on the map due to field congestion, with a STYLE_FIT penalty of 0.90 and a fade-in-finish flag to boot; five runs in the form book show five last-placed finishes, and Gavin Cromwell's stable (7/68 in 14 days) has volume but limited recent strike rate at this level.
runners_data.comment: Let It Settle has been unplaced in each of her last five starts, a run of form that offers little encouragement, though she does have today's trip and ground already proven. Rated 91, she can't be dismissed but needs to find considerably more.

runners_data.name: Maxicourt
runners_data.note: Holds up naturally but cannot get to his preferred rear position in a 26-runner field; the form line 008-9P includes a pulled-up and a ninth over this trip, and the STYLE_FIT discount (0.90) underlines the challenge of adapting to a midfield role.
runners_data.comment: Maxicourt's recent starts read pulled up, 9th, 8th and two unplaced efforts, offering little to work with, though he does have today's trip and ground already proven. Rated 96, he's respected on our figures but the recent form gives little backing.

runners_data.name: Theanniversary Man
runners_data.note: Two recent wins (1-1) in the form string make him one of the more interesting hold-up types despite being redistributed into midfield; however, his good-ground figures (13 from 15 runs) are not encouraging, and Kevin Sexton must overcome significant positional disadvantage to deliver a late challenge.
runners_data.comment: Theanniversary Man landed back-to-back wins earlier in this sequence but has since found only a pulled-up run and a modest 4th last time. He does have today's trip and ground covered, but a rating of 81 means there is more to prove than most.

runners_data.name: Bob The Builder
runners_data.note: Nine-year-old genuine hold-up type who cannot secure his natural position here; 315 days off and a fade-in-finish tag combine with a STYLE_FIT discount of 0.90 to make him a very speculative play, even if the form over shorter trips on good ground is passable.
runners_data.comment: Bob The Builder has been a model of consistency without ever threatening to win, racking up three 5ths in his last five starts, and already has today's trip and ground covered. Rated 95, he's competitive but needs more to trouble the front end.

runners_data.name: Getaway Henry
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who won last time out over this exact 16f trip on good ground (1/16f/GOO) — the most directly relevant recent form in this race; two wins from 15 similar-going starts and the b headgear suggest he is in a settled rhythm, and Gavin Brouder has strong local course knowledge.
runners_data.comment: A win last time, bouncing back after a pulled-up run, is the headline. He has today's trip and ground covered, and a second sits deeper in the form, though our 84 rating leaves a little to find in a big field of 26 — a fair each-way midfield sort.

runners_data.name: Bruise Hill
runners_data.note: Five-year-old with a fade-in-finish flag and just three career runs, all on good ground, placing 8th, 14th, and 15th; redistributed from his natural rear position into midfield, and the STYLE_FIT discount (0.90) reflects that he is unlikely to settle where he needs to.
runners_data.comment: Bruise Hill's recent form is modest — unplaced last time, with an 8th, another unplaced run and a 9th among the other starts, plus a pulled-up effort further back — and he returns after 87 days off. Little has gone right, but he remains lightly raced and open to more.

runners_data.name: Drumadeise
runners_data.note: Three runs, three zeros in the form string — 11th, 13th, 12th on good ground — and returning just 25 days after the last of those efforts; pushed into midfield from true hold-up territory, and there is no evidence yet that he can compete at handicap level.
runners_data.comment: Drumadeise has been unplaced in all three of her starts, and a rating of 69 marks her among the outsiders. She does have today's ground already proven, but there's little in this sparse book to suggest she can trouble those above her.

runners_data.name: El Regalo
runners_data.note: A fader whose form 896P-8 includes a pulled-up and a string of mid-pack finishes; the b headgear is noted, and 40 days since last run is adequate, but good-ground form over varying trips offers no platform for optimism in a 26-runner field with a STYLE_FIT discount of 0.90.
runners_data.comment: El Regalo's recent form makes grim reading - 8th, pulled up, 6th, 9th and 8th in his last five - though he does have today's trip and ground already covered. Rated 79, he sits toward the bottom of the field with little to inspire more.

runners_data.name: Lunar Landscape
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with the highest STYLE_FIT score among the redistributed runners (0.93), suggesting he may adapt best to midfield compared to others in the same group; yet the form 7/00-6 and a sequence of double-figure finishes on good and heavy ground make him hard to recommend.
runners_data.comment: Lunar Landscape has been beaten in each of his last four starts, with 6th his best effort, and a rating of 76 leaves him toward the rear of this field. He does have today's trip and ground already proven, but there's little recent form to work with.

runners_data.name: Maralinga
runners_data.note: An eight-year-old fader who has finished 10th or worse in all five of her recent good-ground runs including a 19th; the STYLE_FIT discount (0.91) and persistent tail-end finishes combine to make her one of the least likely winners in the field.
runners_data.comment: Maralinga has been unplaced in all five of his recent starts, a sequence that offers little encouragement, though he does have today's trip and ground already proven. Rated 83, he can't be dismissed on our figures, but the recent book gives scant reason for optimism.

runners_data.name: Avandra
runners_data.note: Hold-up type whose best recent effort was a 2nd on good ground over 16f, providing one credible data point; P J Rothwell's yard has been active (3/28 in 14 days) and the tb headgear combination is noted, though the STYLE_FIT discount (0.92) and redistribution limit her prospects of landing a clean run.
runners_data.comment: Avandra was a promising 2nd the run before her latest, but either side of that has managed only 8th, unplaced and 7th. Rated 72 toward the bottom of the field, she has today's trip and ground already proven, but lacks consistency.

runners_data.name: Doyen Og
runners_data.note: Seven-day turnaround is very quick, fade-in-finish flag is active, and a pulled-up in the form string raises jumping questions; STYLE_FIT penalty of 0.91 applies as a true hold-up horse, and the b headgear suggests connections are seeking more focus rather than addressing a fundamental class issue.
runners_data.comment: Doyen Og showed a fair 4th at the start of this recent run but has since managed only midfield-and-worse efforts, including a pulled-up run and a 7th last time. She is quick to reappear, just 7 days on, with today's trip and ground already covered, though rated 80 there is plenty to find.

runners_data.name: Ray Gun
runners_data.note: No jockey listed which is a concern, and the form 800P-P includes two pulled-ups in recent starts suggesting a jumping or soundness issue; three runs on similar going yield no wins or places, and hg:t headgear has not resolved the problem thus far.
runners_data.comment: Ray Gun's recent book is troubling - two pulled-up runs and two unplaced efforts either side of an 8th - and he already knows today's trip. Rated 89, he stays in touch on our figures but needs those repeated non-completions behind him.

runners_data.name: Small Bucks
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with a fade-in-finish flag and a form line that includes a pulled-up; best recent effort was 4th over 18f on good ground, suggesting the trip may be on the short side, and 35 days since last run is standard but nothing here stands out as a positive pace-shape trigger.
runners_data.comment: Small Bucks was a fair 4th the run before her latest, though the picture either side is patchier with a pulled-up run and two unplaced efforts, and she already has today's trip and ground covered. A rating of 96 keeps her in this field's reckoning.

runners_data.name: Stily
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with a tidy recent form string — three seconds and a third from six placings on good ground — making him one of the most consistent performers in
runners_data.comment: Stily's latest ended prematurely when pulled up, but that followed a 2nd, 3rd and 3rd in the three starts before - form better than the finish suggests. He already has today's trip and ground covered, and a rating of 85 looks fair reward.

races.paceDynamic: Gino Bella is the one confirmed front-runner in a 26-runner field, and with no genuine challenger for the lead, Alan O'Sullivan can dictate a controlled, unhurried gallop from the front — a sustainable pace that is unlikely to be pressured into anything punishing. Cloudio and Jay Pee M are the most credible prominent horses capable of tracking Gino Bella through the race, while Getaway Henry and Stily add further mid-to-front presence. The field is heavily loaded with hold-up types, but the sheer volume means horses such as Footstepstoglory, Maxicourt, Let It Settle, Theanniversary Man, and Bob The Builder — all true closers by nature — cannot get to the rear of a 26-runner field in their natural role and will be shuffled into a midfield they do not truly own. With one front-runner setting a measured pace on good ground over 2m1f, this race shape strongly favours prominent horses that can travel close to the steady tempo and produce their effort when the leader quickens, rather than closers who will face a wall of traffic and a pace that is unlikely to soften the ground for a sustained late surge.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Gino Bella Controls Cleanly
scenarios.trigger: If Gino Bella jumps fluently and is allowed to bowl along unchallenged, setting a true but sustainable tempo that suits those tracking closely.
scenarios.body: Gino Bella dictates from the front on a good surface over a trip he has placed over before, controlling the fractions and delivering a measured gallop that asks questions only in the straight; prominent horses that have tracked within two or three lengths are best positioned to pounce. This is the dominant shape given the absence of any pace rival, and it rewards those who can travel prominently without getting into a battle.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Grab It
scenarios.trigger: If Cloudio or Getaway Henry track the leader throughout and Gino Bella weakens in the straight, allowing a prominent challenger to collar him.
scenarios.body: With the pace modest and controlled, a horse that has sat second or third throughout can produce a clean run to the line without needing to navigate traffic; Getaway Henry's recent win at this trip on good ground and Cloudio's form in similar conditions make both credible beneficiaries. The steady gallop means stamina reserves are intact for a prolonged duel in the straight rather than a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midfield Horse Splits Them
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is slow enough to compress the field and a horse mapped to midfield finds a gap in the straight to mount an unexpected challenge.
scenarios.body: A modest tempo in a 26-runner field can create a concertina effect where mid-division horses are closer than their map position suggests at the top of the straight; Eaglewood, fresh from a 277-day absence but with good-ground form, or Theanniversary Man, who has won twice recently, could capitalise if the gaps open. However, the redistribution of true hold-up horses into this zone means genuine closers are competing for the same ground, making clean passages harder to find.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Closers Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is surprisingly strong and the field strings out enough for genuine hold-up horses to pick off tired rivals late.
scenarios.body: This scenario requires a materially faster gallop than the one lone front-runner is expected to set, and the bulk of the true closers — Footstepstoglory, Let It Settle, Maxicourt — are redistributed out of their natural rear-of-field role, reducing their effectiveness. Even if the pace quickens, 26 runners on good ground over 2m1f is a congested environment that rarely rewards horses coming from the back, and none of the true hold-up types here have the form figures to justify confidence.

runners_data.name: Brosna Queen
runners_data.note: Sole confirmed front-runner in the race; has winning form over 19f on Good going and should lead unchallenged, but carries 169lbs and faces a step up in field size that may test her ability to control proceedings all the way to the wire.
runners_data.comment: Brosna Queen struck last time out, bouncing back from a mixed run of 5th, 6th, a pulled-up effort and another 5th, and she already knows today's ground. That improvement makes her our pick on profile, with the recent inconsistency the only slight concern.

runners_data.name: Preparations
runners_data.note: 445-day absence (168 days since a Flat run counts as fresh over jumps too) is a serious concern; Flat form on Standard going doesn't translate clearly to 2m4f hurdles on Good, and the yard's 1/14 recent strike rate adds no confidence for a first-time jumps run.
runners_data.comment: Preparations was down the field last time out having landed a win only one start earlier, a big swing that leaves her true level unclear, and she already knows today's ground. Rated 106, she can't be ruled out, but the tiny recent sample urges caution.

runners_data.name: Arctic Flame
runners_data.note: Prominent type with two wins at 18-20f on Good, most recently a runner-up over this sort of trip; headgear worn, trainer sending out a runner without a recent strike rate boost, but the horse's own profile suits this trip and going.
runners_data.comment: Arctic Flame was runner-up last time out and has a win and another second among her recent starts, a strong profile with today's trip and ground already covered. Rated 117, she is a major threat to our selection, though the 57-day absence is a concern.

runners_data.name: Surfin Usa
runners_data.note: Mullins-trained and running off a recent 26-day turnaround; won over 22f on Good last time and the 3/33 trainer strike rate over 14 days is solid — trips and going conditions are exactly right, and Brian Hayes is a major positive.
runners_data.comment: A win last time out is the recent highlight for the mare, and she knows today's ground. Our 104 rating and a placed effort earlier in her short recent sequence keep her competitive, though a below-par run in between shows the form is not yet fully settled.

runners_data.name: Early Bird
runners_data.note: Won over 16f Good and placed over 19f Soft; prominent racer with headgear, but the 60-day absence is a minor query and the 5-lb claimer riding is a slight offset in a big field.
runners_data.comment: Early Bird landed a win at the start of this recent run and has stayed competitive since, with a 2nd two starts back her next-best effort, and she already knows today's ground. Rated 114, she is a leading danger, though the 60-day gap since her latest run is a query.

runners_data.name: Somersby Roost
runners_data.note: Won over 19f Good last time out which is directly relevant; headgear worn, prominent style, and the horse has placed on Soft too — the inconsistency in the form string (P in latest) needs to be respected, however.
runners_data.comment: Somersby Roost's latest ended in a non-completion, but that followed a success the run before, with 3rd and 4th further back showing solid form, and she already has today's trip and ground covered. Rated 110, she remains firmly in this field's calculations despite that blip.

runners_data.name: Diamond Tipp
runners_data.note: Jack Kennedy is an obvious positional upgrade in a big field, but the horse's form on Good going is limited (10/12 average finishing position on similar ground) and recent finishes of 8-P-8 suggest vulnerability at this level.
runners_data.comment: Diamond Tipp was 3rd in two of her earlier starts but has since found only 8ths either side of a pulled-up run, and already knows today's ground. Winless in that spell, she's rated well above her official mark at 111, and can't be dismissed.

runners_data.name: Costanuci
runners_data.note: Nine-year-old veteran who prefers to race prominently but is pushed back into a midfield role here by the sheer number of pace-seeking rivals — racing against its natural instinct with a style-fit discount applies; no wins in recent form on Good.
runners_data.comment: Costanuci has managed nothing better than 4th in her last five starts, with two pulled-up efforts among them, yet she tops our figures at 118 and already knows today's trip and ground. That gap between recent form and rating makes her the chief danger here.

runners_data.name: Glitz And Glamour
runners_data.note: Won at 18f on Good and placed over 24f Good, so trip and ground fit; a 7lb amateur on board is a significant question mark in a big competitive handicap, and recent form shows a pulled-up run at the end of the string.
runners_data.comment: Glitz And Glamour's latest ended prematurely when pulled up, following a well-held 9th, though a 3rd three starts back and a win at the start of this run show more to offer. She already knows today's ground, and rated 102 she fits into this field on her day.

runners_data.name: Bossy Bird
runners_data.note: Hold-up type flagged as fading in the finish; the 7lb claim doesn't offset the worrying tendency to be one-paced late, and the form on Good shows four finishes out of the frame.
runners_data.comment: Bossy Bird has struggled to make an impact, with two 8ths and an unplaced run outweighing a best of 4th in her last four starts. A rating of 93 leaves her near the bottom of the field, though she does already know today's ground.

runners_data.name: Lakewood Rose
runners_data.note: Consistent placer who naturally wants to race prominently but is squeezed into a midfield slot by field congestion; all five runs on Good this season show finishes between 3rd and 6th — honest but without a win in nine Good-ground starts.
runners_data.comment: Lakewood Rose has been a model of consistency, with a 3rd her best of five recent starts and never out of the first six. She already has today's trip and ground covered, and a rating of 106 keeps her firmly involved here.

runners_data.name: Evelyn
runners_data.note: Genuine hold-up type wearing a tongue-tie and a hood; placed on Good and Soft but recent form includes a pulled-up run, and finishing positions in double figures on comparable ground limit the appeal significantly.
runners_data.comment: Evelyn's latest ended in a pulled-up run, though she had shown a fair 3rd three starts back, and she already has today's trip and ground covered. Winless in that spell, a rating of 100 puts her around midfield on these figures.

runners_data.name: Felicity Smoak
runners_data.note: Four-year-old returning from a 195-day absence (33 days since a Flat run); Paul Nolan has 3/16 over 14 days which is reasonable, but the Flat form base over shorter trips does not make this trip over hurdles obvious.
runners_data.comment: Felicity Smoak has managed just one top-five finish in her last five starts, a modest spread that leaves her among the outsiders on a rating of 99. She does already know today's ground, but there is little in the recent book to inspire confidence.

runners_data.name: Ellens Pride
runners_data.note: Flagged as prone to fading in the finish and has won recently over 18f Good, but recent runs show 4th and two other unplaced efforts on Good — the fade flag combined with a big 18-runner field makes the late run scenario difficult.
runners_data.comment: Bottom of our 18 on 83 and hard to fancy. She landed a win three starts back and has a placed effort on her card, but the form has cooled — a modest fourth last time, with an unplaced run just before. Today's trip and ground are covered, but she needs to bounce back.

runners_data.name: Loughrask Jet
runners_data.note: True hold-up type that the map has shifted to midfield given rear-cluster congestion; every run in five starts on Good has produced a finish of 7th or worse — the fade flag and style displacement make this very hard to recommend.
runners_data.comment: Loughrask Jet has been beaten throughout her last five starts, never finishing better than 7th, though a rating of 94 - clear of her official mark - offers a sliver of hope. She already knows today's trip and ground, but the recent book is bleak.

runners_data.name: Tudorista
runners_data.note: 253-day absence and a four-year-old mapping into midfield against its natural hold-up instincts; all five Good-ground runs have produced finishes between 4th and 12th, and the long layoff adds further risk.
runners_data.comment: Tudorista was a fair 4th in two of her earlier starts but has since found only 8th, 9th and an unplaced effort, and now returns after 253 days off. She does know today's ground, and a rating of 97 offers some hope despite the lengthy absence.

runners_data.name: Ballinearla Girl
runners_data.note: Genuine prominent racer — 5th and 3rd on Good at 17f and 16f — but the field is too congested for her to find that position naturally; the style-fit flag applies and an 83-day absence after a run of 0-0-7-3-5 in recent starts limits the case.
runners_data.comment: Ballinearla Girl was a fair 3rd the run before her latest, and returns after an 83-day absence with today's trip and ground already covered. A rating of 102 - well above her official mark - keeps her firmly in the picture despite modest efforts either side of that placing.

runners_data.name: Liss Eile
runners_data.note: Natural hold-up type redistributed into midfield; form shows repeated finishes around 10th on Good ground at 16f — the combination of true running style being obscured, a 7lb claim, and weak recent form makes this a very difficult proposition.
runners_data.comment: Liss Eile has managed only a 4th in her last five starts, with a pulled-up run and a 7th among the rest, though a rating of 94 - above her official mark - offers a shred of hope. She already knows today's ground, but the picture remains poor.

races.paceDynamic: Brosna Queen is the single confirmed front-runner in an 18-runner field and, crucially, faces no genuine rival willing to seriously contest the lead — she should dictate from the front at a controlled, sustainable gallop on Good ground over 2m4f. However, this field is overloaded with prominent-types: Arctic Flame, Surfin Usa, Early Bird, Somersby Roost, Diamond Tipp, and Glitz And Glamour all want to race close to the pace, meaning a scrappy early scramble for position is inevitable behind Brosna Queen, with Costanuci, Lakewood Rose, and Ballinearla Girl — all genuine prominent racers — pushed back into midfield against their natural instincts. The field holds more front-running and prominent types than can all secure their favoured berth, with Arctic Flame, Surfin Usa, and Early Bird best-placed by profile and quality to actually hold prominent ground. With Brosna Queen controlling tempo from the front and a cluster of prominent types burning energy to settle into position, this race shape most rewards a well-handicapped runner that can sit comfortably in the first five, conserve energy through the early jostling, and sustain a quality gallop from the home turn — the prominent profile with tactical ease wins here, not the late closer.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Sets Up Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If Brosna Queen leads unchallenged at a fair clip and the prominent types settle behind without excessive early burn.
scenarios.body: Brosna Queen dictates an honest but manageable tempo, and the horses that track her in the first three to five get the perfect low-energy journey before kicking from two out; the redistribution of Costanuci, Lakewood Rose, and Ballinearla Girl into midfield leaves the genuine prominent slots for the likes of Surfin Usa, Arctic Flame, and Early Bird, all of whom have the class and going form to capitalise.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses, Front Pair Clear
scenarios.trigger: If the early jostling for position burns out the prominent pack and the leader and one tracking rival steal an unassailable advantage from the home turn.
scenarios.body: Brosna Queen's controlled lead becomes a race-winning advantage if the field behind her spends energy sorting positions in the first mile; one horse locked onto her immediately — most likely Arctic Flame or Surfin Usa — gets a free rail to the last and holds on as tired rivals fail to close.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midfield Swoopers Land Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong enough to compromise the prominent types and leave the race open for a midfield runner finishing best of all.
scenarios.body: A truly hot early gallop caused by multiple prominent types refusing to concede position would string the field out and leave energy-efficient midfielders in the best spot turning for home; Evelyn and Felicity Smoak, though genuine hold-up types, need the front end to have run themselves into the ground, and Diamond Tipp — a natural prominent type with Good-ground form — could benefit if dropped slightly off the pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Scramble, Outsider Profits
scenarios.trigger: If the large field produces interference, a false pace, or key fancied runners lose their position badly in the early battle.
scenarios.body: With 18 runners, a tight Cork track, and multiple misplaced prominent types shuffled into midfield, a chaotic race where form lines are scrambled is a genuine possibility; a lightly-weighted runner like Somersby Roost — who has won on this ground and distance profile and carries a headgear flag — could take advantage if the market leaders all end up in trouble.

watchPoints.text: Surfin Usa and Brosna Queen — watch for whether Mullins' runner (Surfin Usa) presses the leader early or settles, as any pressure on Brosna Queen could transform the race tempo dramatically.

Costanuci, Lakewood Rose, and Ballinearla Girl — all natural prominent types forced into midfield by field congestion; if any of them push forward aggressively in the first half-mile, expect a flashpoint of pace that disrupts the whole field's rhythm.

Diamond Tipp — Jack Kennedy represents a significant jockey upgrade but the horse's Good-ground stats are poor; watch whether Kennedy opts to drop it out rather than take its natural prominent position, which would misalign the style profile further.

Felicity Smoak and Preparations — both returning from significant absences under trainer yards with recent strike rates to monitor; a well-being check on both at the start is worthwhile before placing these in any race shape.

Glitz And Glamour — the 7lb amateur claim in a field this large could create an early positioning problem if the rider struggles to find a clear run from the prominent draw; watch how she settles in the first three furlongs.

races.name: Follow Us On X Maiden Hurdle

runners_data.name: Ajp Falco
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with a concerning record of fades in the finish (tagged ⚠ fades); recent form of 00-FPF over trips up to 3m on good is deeply uninspiring, and coming from the rear in a single-pace race makes the task harder still.

runners_data.name: C Pas Possible
runners_data.note: Lightly raced five-year-old with one placing from one hurdle run on good ground; unknown style (U) but that single placed effort suggests ability, and Phillip Enright is an experienced guide for a horse with a short form profile.

runners_data.name: Jeroboam Machin
runners_data.note: Prominent-style runner with two hurdle wins to his name — the standout winning CV in this field — though those came on soft and heavy ground; this step up to good ground at 3m is a legitimate query for Emmet Mullins' seven-year-old.

runners_data.name: Mind Eraser
runners_data.note: Unknown going suitability and unknown style with a point-to-point pull-up on record (47P); Mary Elliott Doyle runner with no relevant going or trip data to assess — complete unknown quantity whose form string offers little confidence.

runners_data.name: Riverstown Boy
runners_data.note: Lightly raced with an uninspiring sequence of 5s and Ps; returning quickly after just eight days, the five-year-old has form on good ground but has never threatened and Alan O'Sullivan's claim won't paper over the lack of form.

runners_data.name: The Boysofairhill
runners_data.note: Hold-up type whose recent form figures on good ground (7, 11, 8, 5) tell a consistent story of finishing in the pack; returning after just seven days and with no wins or places from four runs on good, the trip looks his best hope but the style is a disadvantage here.

runners_data.name: Withabitofluk
runners_data.note: Prominent runner from the De Bromhead yard, sporting tongue-tie and a hood, with a placed effort at 2m4f on good ground; Dylan Whelan (7lb claimer) takes some of the trainer's strong 14-day record off the boil, but this is the most formful yard in the race.

runners_data.name: Young Doran
runners_data.note: The lone confirmed front-runner in the field who will shape the entire race from flag to finish; his one hurdle run produced a second place at 2m6f on good, which suggests he handles the conditions, though the STYLE_FIT flag notes he may be racing slightly out of role and that tempers blind faith in his price.

runners_data.name: Deerpark Lassie
runners_data.note: David Harry Kelly's second runner with no listed days since last run and a weight advantage at 159lbs; no form data at all available for this five-year-old filly, making any assessment speculative.

runners_data.name: Howyasox
runners_data.note: Hold-up type whose four runs on good ground returned figures of 6, 7, 8, 7 — consistently mid-to-rear pack; the amateur rider Mr S P Queally (7) faces a stiff task dragging this one into the frame from the back of a compressed field.

runners_data.name: Pegasuslane
runners_data.note: Tagged as a hold-up runner who fades in the finish, and the headgear (blinkers) has not sparked improvement in a short form line of 0-P; Gavin Brouder takes the ride but the raw evidence from two runs suggests this is a horse finding its level.

runners_data.name: Sound Judgement
runners_data.note: Jack Kennedy's mount for Gordon Elliott — the dominant trainer angle in the race with a 9/43 14-day record — and this six-year-old has placed twice from five hurdle starts including on good ground at 3m equivalent trips; the prominent style and class of handler make this the most credentialed challenger to the front-runner.

runners_data.name: Star Cave
runners_data.note: 229 days off the track (point-to-point pull-up) and unknown going suitability; the form string of 7/322- shows some placed efforts but the lengthy absence and tongue-tie make him an uncertain proposition returning to action for Patrick T Foley.

races.paceDynamic: Young Doran is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 13-runner maiden hurdle over 3m at Cork on good ground, and with no other natural lead horse to press or challenge him, he is almost certain to control tempo from the outset. Withabitofluk and Sound Judgement are the other prominent-style runners who will track in his slipstream, while the bulk of the field — including Ajp Falco, The Boysofairhill, Howyasox, and Pegasuslane — are hold-up types who will be detached in the pack through the early stages. With a single uncontested pace-setter over a stamina-sapping 3 miles on good ground, the gallop is likely to be measured rather than searching, meaning the race will be won relatively close to the pace and not by horses coming from the rear. This shape heavily favours prominent-to-lead runners who can conserve energy through a controlled early tempo and quicken off it in the home straight, with true hold-up closers facing a stern test of getting competitive from rear if the tempo never truly punishes those up front.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Lead Holds Firm
scenarios.trigger: If Young Doran dictates an uncontested, measured tempo and the prominent trackers lack the finishing surge to collar him.
scenarios.body: Young Doran sets a sustainable gallop over the 3m trip with no rival bothering him up front, arriving at the final two hurdles full of running; Sound Judgement and Withabitofluk, tracking closely, are best placed to capitalise if Young Doran flattens out but the lead horse's control gives him a significant advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Young Doran's measured pace leaves him vulnerable late and a close tracker lands a decisive blow jumping the last.
scenarios.body: Sound Judgement (Jack Kennedy, Gordon Elliott, proven at 3m+ equivalent trips on good) or Withabitofluk move smoothly past a tiring Young Doran from the second-last; the De Bromhead runner showed a placed effort at 2m4f on good and has the fitness and headgear to be sharper this time.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midfield Horse Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely slow enough to compress the field and a midfield runner with latent ability produces a strong late run.
scenarios.body: Jeroboam Machin, with two prior hurdle wins and the most experienced winning profile in the field, travels up from a prominent-midfield position and finds enough to close; C Pas Possible, placed on good ground and lightly raced with scope, also represents a type that could benefit from a compressed finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Lands Late
scenarios.trigger: If something unexpected forces a faster-than-anticipated pace and the field strings out, allowing a genuine hold-up type to pick off rivals late.
scenarios.body: Ajp Falco or The Boysofairhill would need a contested, end-to-end gallop to make their hold-up styles pay, but their recent form figures and tendency to fade in the finish make this outcome the least likely in a single-paced affair.

watchPoints.text: Young Doran dictates everything from the front — watch whether Shane O'Callaghan (3) presses or allows a crawl, as the tempo he sets will determine whether hold-up horses have any chance of getting competitive.

Sound Judgement is the most interesting market mover to monitor given Jack Kennedy's booking and Gordon Elliott's hot 14-day strike rate; if punted into short odds before the off, it signals stable confidence in this step up to 3m on good.

Jeroboam Machin's two wins came on soft and heavy ground — watch the pre-race market for any sign the Mullins camp are confident the good ground won't blunt his finishing effort, as it is a genuine question mark over his profile.

Withabitofluk runs in hood and tongue-tie for De Bromhead; headgear retained from last run when second at 2m4f on good — no fitness concern but the hood is not new, so do not over-read it as a wind-up angle.

Three runners (Mind Eraser, Deerpark Lassie, Star Cave) arrive with significant unknowns — absence, no data, or point-to-point pull-ups — and any one of them drifting sharply in the market pre-race should be noted as a potential indicator of stable pessimism.

races.name: RBC Brewin Dolphin Hurdle

runners_data.name: Happy Jacky
runners_data.note: A 12-year-old who remains competitive off OR=140, with four wins from nine runs on similar Going and a positive recent form figure of 1 in his last five; tracking Maxxum closely is his natural role and this trip at 3m suits his profile well, though a 46-day break is worth monitoring at his age.
runners_data.comment: Two wins in his last five starts underline useful recent form, though the latest outing yielded only a 6th. Proven over today's distance and going, Happy Jacky shoulders a big 164lb and is only 8th of 11 on our figures.

runners_data.name: Hewick
runners_data.note: Top-rated at OR=145 and a genuine hold-up horse for John Joseph Hanlon, but a 71-day absence and a sequence reading 457P9 tells a story of a horse who has lost his sharpness at 11 years old; his two wins in 15 similar-going runs is a concern and he needs everything to go right late.
runners_data.comment: Hewick heads this field on our figures, backed by an official mark of 145. His last three read 9th, pulled up and 7th, but he's fresh after 71 days and proven over today's distance and going - yet to score in five, that dip the one query against a clear rating edge.

runners_data.name: Reverend Hubert
runners_data.note: 315 days off the track is the dominant factor here — a very long absence for an 8-year-old who won at 16f and 18f on Good ground in his better days; Phillip Enright takes the ride and the horse has Good-ground form, but this level of freshness at 3m in a competitive hurdle asks significant questions.
runners_data.comment: Third last time out and a win a couple of starts earlier make him a strong threat, with today's distance and going proven. Rated 134, fourth of 11 on our figures, the one unplaced blip in that sequence is the only real knock against a progressive sort.

runners_data.name: Smooth Tom
runners_data.note: Andrew Slattery's 7-year-old is a natural hold-up horse with three wins from ten on Good-comparable going; the 46-day turnaround is fine, but dropping from shorter trips in heavy ground to 3m on Good stretches his profile, and Cian Quirke will need to manage him carefully from the rear.
runners_data.comment: A winner three starts back, Smooth Tom has since found little, following a 3rd with a below-par 6th last time out. Six weeks since that run, he's proven over today's going, but a rating of 131 leaves him only 7th of 11 on these figures.

runners_data.name: Topgun Simmy
runners_data.note: Five-year-old who won over 3m and 26f on Good ground within his last five, making the trip and going combination a genuine fit; a prominent racer, 326 days off the track is the serious question — Donagh Meyler rides for a yard with 2 wins from 19 in 14 days, suggesting the stable is in decent nick.
runners_data.comment: Topgun Simmy won last time out, backing up an earlier success two runs before that with a 9th in between, but that form is now 326 days old. Proven over today's distance and going and rated 132, 6th of 11, the season-plus absence is the obvious concern back off this lengthy break.

runners_data.name: Da Capo Glory
runners_data.note: Consistent place-getter at OR=132 with two recent seconds on Good ground over staying trips; the hood (p) is noted and Alan O'Sullivan (5) is a 5lb claimer — he is a natural front-pressing type who has the ability to run well fresh but his similar-going record of 0 wins from 7 tugs against him at this level.
runners_data.comment: Da Capo Glory was runner-up on each of his last two starts, quick to return just 34 days later, with an unseat and patchier form before that. Proven over today's distance and going and rated 133, 5th of 11, he is yet to win in his last five despite the resilient recent placings.

runners_data.name: Desert Cave
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated runner in the field at OR=102 and a genuine hold-up horse by inclination, though mapped to midfield here given the congestion at the rear; back after just 8 days which is an unusual turnaround, and a form string of 565-00 gives no encouragement — the visor is retained but this looks a very tough ask.
runners_data.comment: Desert Cave has managed little better than midfield in his recent starts, twice finishing unplaced among a run of 5ths and a 6th, and sits bottom of this field on our figures. He is race-fit, having run just 8 days ago, and proven over today's distance and going, but the modest form here is hard to overlook.

runners_data.name: Linden Arden
runners_data.note: Returned from 110 days off and races here as a natural pace-presser who will find it difficult to secure that position with several similar types in the field; his best form has come on Yielding-to-Heavy at Fairyhouse and the switch to Good at Cork on this trip looks against him on the going figures (7/15 sim-going).
runners_data.comment: Hard to fancy on our figures, 10th of 11 on 124. He won four starts back but the form has since faded, well beaten in his last two starts and returning from 110 days off. Today's distance and going are proven, but he needs to bounce back from a clear downward curve.

runners_data.name: Maxxum
runners_data.note: Gordon Elliott's OR=146 top-weight is the confirmed lone front-runner and Jack Kennedy gives him every chance to dictate; his similar-going record is limited (6/15, 0 wins on Good) which is a genuine flag, but in a race where he faces no pace rival his ability to control tempo at 3m on Good ground makes him structurally very well placed.
runners_data.comment: A win three starts back and a big rating edge — 148, second of 11 on our figures and well clear of his official mark — mark him a leading player, with today's distance and going both proven. The only caveat is a slight dip over his last couple of starts, but the figures point higher.

runners_data.name: Roi Mage
runners_data.note: A 14-year-old veteran who is a natural prominent racer but will struggle to assert that role in this crowded field; his best form has come on Yielding or Heavy (1/15 on similar going is a damning stat for Good ground), and at this age the combination of trip, going, and being shuffled out of his preferred position is stacked against him.
runners_data.comment: Runner-up last time and a leading threat on our figures, 141 and third of 11. He landed a win earlier in this short recent sequence, and while a pulled-up run since and a 115-day absence are queries, the placed efforts either side of that blip and today's proven going make him dangerous.

runners_data.name: Mousey Brown
runners_data.note: Dermot McLoughlin's 9-year-old wears a hood (t) and comes back after 46 days, a natural hold-up horse who has been consistently placed at 4th and 5th but rarely threatens to win; eleven runs on similar going with just one success suggests he finds it hard to land a blow at this level, and Alix Balfe's 7lb claim is a modest consolation.
runners_data.comment: Mousey Brown has been a model of consistency without ever threatening to win, with finishes of 4th, 5th, 5th and a fall before a modest 4th last time out. Proven over today's distance and going, she carries a lighter 147lb, but a rating of just 128, 9th of 11, makes her hard to fancy as more than makeweight.

races.paceDynamic: Maxxum is the confirmed front-runner here and, with Jack Kennedy aboard for Gordon Elliott, he is likely to control this at a manageable, sustainable gallop over 3m on Good ground at Cork — there is no meaningful pace rival to force his hand from the front. The hold-up contingent of Hewick, Reverend Hubert, and Smooth Tom will settle in behind, while Happy Jacky and Topgun Simmy are genuine prominent types who will look to track Maxxum closely. This field holds more prominent and hold-up types than the race shape can naturally accommodate — Roi Mage, Linden Arden, and Da Capo Glory are all genuine pace-pressing horses who will be shuffled into midfield positions against their nature, meaning several will race less than ideally. A controlled, honest gallop over this trip on Good ground with one unchallenged leader sets this race up squarely for horses who can race prominently or travel just off the pace and pick up between the last two flights — the prominent-to-midfield profile is the profile to be on.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Maxxum Controls, Pace Horses Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Maxxum leads at his own tempo and the race unfolds at a steady-to-honest gallop with no serious front-end pressure.
scenarios.body: Maxxum dictates on a long rein, the prominent trackers get the run of the race jumping fluently, and the winner is likely to come from those travelling just behind the leader from the second half of the race onward; the hold-up brigade are left with too little to pass on Good ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Finish Fast
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is marginally stronger than expected and the closers get a proper gallop to chase late over this 3m trip.
scenarios.body: Hewick, Reverend Hubert, or Smooth Tom get into a rhythm off the pace and produce their best finishes when the tempo stretches the field from three out; on Good ground over 3m this is viable but requires the pace to be genuine rather than dawdled.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses, Front Runner Capitalises
scenarios.trigger: If Maxxum is gifted an entirely uncontested lead and the field fails to close the gap at any meaningful point in the race.
scenarios.body: Maxxum, unextended and unhurried, simply stays on powerfully and the hold-up horses are stranded too far back having conserved energy through an insufficient gallop; Kennedy's experience in this scenario makes Maxxum a difficult opponent.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Redistribution Chaos, Outsider Scores
scenarios.trigger: If the reshuffled midfielders race keenly out of position and the resulting pace disrupts the race shape unpredictably.
scenarios.body: Horses like Roi Mage or Linden Arden, forced to race against their natural instincts, may unsettle the tempo in the final mile, leaving a market outsider to benefit from the ensuing disorder; this is a low-probability scenario but the overcrowded prominent group makes it non-negligible.

watchPoints.text: Maxxum (Kennedy/Elliott) — watch whether he is allowed to bowl along at his own pace unchallenged; if no rival tests him early, he could control this from the front and prove very hard to peg back.

Happy Jacky — a prominent racer at 12 years old who knows his job and has been placed nine times from fifteen on similar going; if he travels smoothly behind Maxxum through the second mile he could be the one to emerge from the chasing pack.

Topgun Simmy — 326 days off the track for a 5-year-old is a real unknown, but his 3m wins on Good ground and prominent style put him in the right shape for this race; watch whether he travels with his usual fluency early or shows signs of ring-rustiness.

Roi Mage and Linden Arden — both are natural pace-pressers forced into unfamiliar midfield positions by the crowded prominent group; watch for either becoming unsettled or running keenly against their nature, which could unsettle the tempo in the middle portion of the race.

Reverend Hubert — 315 days off the track means his jumping sharpness is the key factor to watch in the early stages; if he is fluent and settles well for Phillip Enright he holds Good-ground form, but any early jumping errors will end his chance in a 3m contest at this level.

races.name: Racing Again July 24th Fillies Flat Race

runners_data.name: Ballyhahill
runners_data.comment: Ballyhahill has yet to threaten as high as she'll need to here, with finishes of 7th and then a better 4th last time out. Proven over today's distance and fit after a rest of 82 days, she's rated 79, 4th of 16, giving her solid claims among the dangers, with limited experience the only real query.

runners_data.name: Bluebell Breeze
runners_data.comment: Bluebell Breeze has raced just once, finishing 4th, and returns 41 days on. Proven over today's distance and going, she's rated 88, 2nd of 16, putting her right among the leading dangers on minimal but promising evidence, with limited experience the obvious caveat.

runners_data.name: Born To Caledonie
runners_data.comment: Born To Caledonie has finished no better than 5th in three runs to date, with a 6th, a 5th and another 5th making for a consistent if unremarkable record. Proven over today's distance and going and race-fit after 41 days, she's rated only 76, 6th of 16, leaving obvious improvement still needed.

runners_data.name: Charlie Shiron
runners_data.comment: Charlie Shiron was unplaced on her only start to date and returns quickly here, just 25 days later. Proven over today's going, she's rated 78, 5th of 16, leaving plenty to find on such limited form.

runners_data.name: Girl From The West
runners_data.comment: Girl From The West is unraced and steps into the unknown on debut. Carrying 159lb, she is unexposed and impossible to assess on figures alone, leaving plenty of scope for improvement once she gets going.

runners_data.name: Highland Call
runners_data.comment: Highland Call makes her debut with no form to go on. Carrying 159lb, she is entirely unexposed, and while that leaves obvious question marks, it also means there is room for significant improvement once she gets a start under her belt.

runners_data.name: Hilly Filly
runners_data.comment: Hilly Filly is unraced and takes her chance on debut with no recorded form. Carrying 159lb, she remains a complete unknown, offering nothing to assess but plenty of potential to grow into once she has a run.

runners_data.name: Honey Buck's
runners_data.comment: Honey Buck's has no recorded form and makes her debut here. Carrying 159lb, she is unexposed and impossible to assess meaningfully at this stage, though that inexperience leaves scope for improvement.

runners_data.name: I'm Gold
runners_data.comment: I'm Gold is another newcomer with no recorded form. Carrying 159lb, she is entirely unexposed on debut, which makes her hard to assess but leaves room for improvement with racing experience.

runners_data.name: Indoor Sport
runners_data.comment: Indoor Sport is unraced and makes her debut here with no recorded form. Carrying 159lb, she is a complete unknown on figures, leaving plenty to find out once she gets going.

runners_data.name: Lavender Berry
runners_data.comment: Lavender Berry has managed only a 9th from her sole start so far and returns 41 days on. Carrying 159lb, the limited evidence offers little encouragement, though barely one run in there means she remains open to improvement.

runners_data.name: Not A Whisper
runners_data.comment: Not A Whisper is unraced and makes her debut in this field with no recorded form. Carrying 159lb, she is a complete unknown, meaning there's nothing concrete to go on but scope to progress with experience.

runners_data.name: The West A Yeats
runners_data.comment: The West A Yeats was a creditable 3rd on her only start and returns in good time, 35 days later. Proven over today's distance and going, she's rated 80, 3rd of 16, making her a leading danger on that solitary but promising effort.

runners_data.name: Tiger In New York
runners_data.comment: Tiger In New York is unraced and has no recorded form heading into her debut. Carrying 159lb, she is entirely unexposed, which makes her hard to assess but leaves the door open for improvement.

runners_data.name: Vadique
runners_data.comment: Vadique was a clear runner-up on her only start, form that puts her top of our figures for this race. Proven over today's distance and going and fit again after 41 days, she's yet to win but that solitary effort marks her out as the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Western Roses
runners_data.comment: Western Roses is unraced and makes her debut here with no recorded form. Carrying 159lb, she is a complete unknown on figures, leaving nothing but potential to assess at this stage.
